messages.text:
We'll put together our power to fight!
Two is better than one!{be01}

Rae: You're even more in sync than we are!{be01}
Ula: Boo-hoo-hooo! We lost!

We're still pretty small, so we can only
stand up to others by working together.{be01}
That's why we battle with two Pokémon
at the same time!

Two! Two! Two is better!
...But what's “better" mean?{be01}

Mommy and Daddy told me that I have
to play fair.{be01}
So you've got to have two Pokémon to do
a Double Battle!
